# GetMyPermit

> GetMyPermit prepares and lodges building permit and council approval applications for homeowners and builders in Perth and Western Australia: sheds, garages, carports, patios, pergolas, decks, granny flats, tiny homes, pools and retrospective approvals.

## Pages

- [Building permits and council approvals, handled for you.](https://getmypermit.com.au/): We prepare and lodge building permits and council approvals for sheds, patios, carports, granny flats, tiny homes and pools in Perth and WA. Fixed price, no runaround.
- [Get your fixed price within one business day](https://getmypermit.com.au/quote): Tell us what you are building in Perth or WA and get a fixed-price quote for your building permit or council approval, usually within one business day.
- [Do I need council approval?](https://getmypermit.com.au/do-i-need-approval): Check if your shed, patio, pergola, carport, deck, granny flat, tiny home or pool needs a building permit or council approval in Western Australia.
- [Retrospective building approval in WA](https://getmypermit.com.au/retrospective-approval): Built a patio, shed, carport or pool without a permit in WA? Here is how retrospective approval (a Building Approval Certificate) works, what it costs and how we handle it.
- [Sell and build. We'll handle council.](https://getmypermit.com.au/for-builders): We prepare and lodge building permits for shed, patio, carport, granny flat, tiny home and pool businesses in Perth and WA. Fixed price per job.
- [About GetMyPermit](https://getmypermit.com.au/about): GetMyPermit is a Perth-based permit paperwork service. We prepare and lodge building permits and council approvals for homeowners and builders across WA.
- [Privacy](https://getmypermit.com.au/privacy): How GetMyPermit collects and uses your details.
- [All our sites](https://getmypermit.com.au/all): Every site in the GetMyPermit family: sheds, pergolas and patios, carports, granny flats, tiny homes and pools in WA.
- [How getting your permit works, step by step](https://getmypermit.com.au/how-it-works): Every step of getting a building permit in Perth and WA, from the free check to the notice of completion, with who does what and how long each part takes.
- [Building permit jargon, in plain English](https://getmypermit.com.au/permit-jargon): BA1, BA2, BA7, R-Codes, setbacks, CDC, Class 10 and more. WA building permit and council approval terms explained in plain English.
- [What doesn't need a building permit in WA?](https://getmypermit.com.au/what-doesnt-need-a-building-permit): Sheds and patios up to 10 m² and 2.4 m, open pergolas up to 20 m², dividing fences up to 2 m, tanks up to 5,000 L: the full WA building permit exemption list in plain English.
- [Which BA form do I need?](https://getmypermit.com.au/which-ba-form): BA1, BA2, BA7, BA13 or BA20? Answer two quick questions and see which WA building form you need, what it is for and the 2026-27 fee.
- [Guides](https://getmypermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to building permits and council approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
- [Our prices, upfront](https://getmypermit.com.au/pricing): Upfront, fixed prices for building permits and council approvals in Perth and WA, with council fees included. Shed or outbuilding from $990.
